title: Imran's Voice Vanished Around a Distant Corner | ECHO//30 Ep. 8
description:
Tara hears Imran beyond the open Red Door, but Rhea reveals the cost: every human who crosses into the Missing Hour forces another trapped person out. If no one chooses, the Door will choose for them.

Tara crosses to ask her brother what he wants. Kavi follows only after finally telling her the truth. Two erased commuters return—but Byte's hidden protocol seals the Door, leaving Kavi and Tara trapped inside at 3:57.
